## Engineering standards

The Vultr inference key lives only in the control plane's environment (`/etc/prereg.env` in production,
`.env` locally, both git-ignored). It is never logged, never sent to the browser and never enters a sandbox.

## File-scoped standards

### Applies to `prereg/runner.py`

Every sandbox is built by `build_command` alone and keeps all of its controls: gVisor runtime, no network,
an empty environment, memory/CPU/process caps, a read-only root, read-only data and code, and destruction
after the step. Files the sandbox writes are untrusted: open them with O_NOFOLLOW and O_NONBLOCK, require a
regular file, and cap the size.

### Applies to `prereg/agent.py`

Every agent loop has an iteration cap from `prereg/config.py` and a deterministic stop. Numbers shown to users
come from the trusted recomputation, never from the model's own claim.
